scenarios.name: SP1-CP-01 valid LLM response produces a valid CapabilityProfile

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid Stage1Profile JSON with zones, entry_points, and kc_subcodes
Stage 1b capability profile is run
a CapabilityProfile model is produced
the capability profile has zones derived from kc_subcodes
the capability profile entry_point_completeness is inferred_partial

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-02 Stage1Profile is promoted via to_capability_profile

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid Stage1Profile JSON
Stage 1b capability profile is run
the Stage1Profile is promoted to a CapabilityProfile
the promoted profile has zones_active derived from kc_subcodes
the promoted profile has has_persistent_memory derived from kc_subcodes

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-03 profile flag skips the LLM call

steps.text: a pre-built capability-profile.yaml at a known path
Stage 1b is run with the profile flag
no LLM call is made for Stage 1b
the loaded CapabilityProfile is returned

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-04 profile flag still produces loss analysis from Stage 1a

steps.text: a pre-built capability-profile.yaml at a known path
a use-case description and risk cards are available
the full SP1 run is executed with the profile flag
a LossAnalysis is produced from Stage 1a
no LLM call is made for Stage 1b
the pre-built CapabilityProfile is loaded

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-05 LLM call is logged with stage stage_1b

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid Stage1Profile JSON
a run directory for call logging
Stage 1b capability profile is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_1b
the call log entry step is capability_profile

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-06 capability profile is written to capability-profile.yaml

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid Stage1Profile JSON
a run directory for output
Stage 1b capability profile is run
a file capability-profile.yaml exists in the run directory
the file contains a valid CapabilityProfile model when read back

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-07 invalid KC sub-codes in LLM response fail validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns a Stage1Profile with invalid KC sub-code KC9.9
Stage 1b capability profile is run
validation fails with error containing Invalid KC sub-code

scenarios.name: SP1-CP-08 loss analysis context is passed to the prompt

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid Stage1Profile JSON
a loss analysis with losses L-1 and L-2 and hazards H-1 and H-2
Stage 1b capability profile is run
the user prompt contains loss analysis context
the user prompt references losses and hazards from the loss analysis

background.text: the STPA system model module is importable
a use-case description and loss analysis are available as input
